newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound/dollar rate barely changed.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound/dollar rate barely changed.

text.p: The Egyptian pound remained unchanged against the dollar in a quiet private sector market on Sunday, bankers said.
They said the Egyptian pound market was still liquid but demand for the dollar had fallen from Thursday, which gave the pound the appearance of strengthening slightly.
"Egyptian pound supply is the same but the demand on the dollar has fallen which weakened it slightly against the pound," one banker said.
Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3920 and 3.3965 pounds bid and 3.3945 and 3.3985 pounds offered in the interbank market.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3943 bid and 3.3961 offered compared to 3.3942 bid and 3.3963 offered on Thursday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.389645 buy and 3.399455 sell.
